config.trade_expansion.title: AK Trade Expansion Settings
config.trade_expansion.server_locked: Cannot be changed while connected to a server. Edit the server's config/trade_expansion.json and run /tradeex reload
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.0: How many copper coins one iron coin is worth. Decide it when creating the world (changing it changes the value of coins already held)
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.1: How many iron coins one gold coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.2: How many gold coins one diamond coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.3: How many diamond coins one netherite coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratioLoc: When on, a world keeps the ratios it was created with even if the setting changes
config.trade_expansion.currency.allowMin: Crafting recipes: 9 copper blocks → copper coins, 9 iron blocks → iron coins. Applies after a restart or /reload
config.trade_expansion.currency.exchange: Fee ratio of the exchange tab
config.trade_expansion.currency.starting: Money given on first login (c) (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.currency.mobDropC: Hostile mobs killed by a player drop a few coins
config.trade_expansion.currency.sneakUse: Sneak + use breaks one coin into the next smaller coins
config.trade_expansion.currency.emeraldC: Coins the stonecutter makes from one emerald block. 0 disables the recipe. Applies after a restart or /reload
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultSpre: Gap between buy and sell prices (default when a good does not set it). Changes existing prices immediately
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultElas: Larger = prices move less per trade (default when a good does not set it)
config.trade_expansion.price.minMultipli: Prices never drop below this share of the base price
config.trade_expansion.price.maxMultipli: Prices never rise above this multiple of the base price
config.trade_expansion.price.jitter.desc: Random spread of base prices in new markets (existing markets keep theirs)
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultMaxS: Stock cap = target stock × this, when a good does not set it
config.trade_expansion.price.globalMulti: Multiplies every price. Changes existing prices immediately
config.trade_expansion.recovery.halfLife: In-game days until a price deviation is halved
config.trade_expansion.recovery.clock.de: GAME_TIME: sleeping does not count / DAY_TIME: sleeping counts. Switching may shift recovery once
config.trade_expansion.distance.mergeRad: Stalls within this distance share one market
config.trade_expansion.distance.nearRadi: Markets within this distance share price changes 100%
config.trade_expansion.distance.farRadiu: Markets farther than this are not affected
config.trade_expansion.distance.falloffE: 1 = linear, 2 = drops quickly just outside the near radius
config.trade_expansion.distance.linkNeth: Treat Nether coordinates × 8 as Overworld coordinates for price links (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.distance.minNewMa: A crafted stall may found a new market only this far from existing markets
config.trade_expansion.market.levelThres: Beds around the market needed for level 2
config.trade_expansion.market.villagerTh: The Nether and the End measure villagers instead of beds
config.trade_expansion.market.levelRadiu: Beds / villagers within this horizontal distance are counted
config.trade_expansion.market.levelCheck: Opening the screen re-measures the level after this many in-game days
config.trade_expansion.wallet.autoCollec: Coins go into the wallet automatically while you carry one
config.trade_expansion.bank.minMarketLev: Markets of at least this level show the bank tab
config.trade_expansion.bank.interestRate: Interest rate per in-game day. 0 = none (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.bank.cardFee.desc: Fee to issue or reissue a card (c)
config.trade_expansion.trade.maxDistance: You must be this close to the stall to trade
config.trade_expansion.trade.acceptDamag: Buy damaged items at a price reduced by durability
config.trade_expansion.trade.priceTolera: Cancel when the price moved more than this ratio from the preview. 0 = any change cancels
config.trade_expansion.trade.allowShiftA: Shift trades the largest possible quantity
config.trade_expansion.trade.allowCreati: Let creative-mode players trade (off by default: infinite items break the economy)
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.spawnSta: Place stalls in newly generated villages. Applies after the server (world) restarts
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.protectN: Naturally generated stalls cannot be broken
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.spawnTra: Place a trader NPC in front of stalls
config.trade_expansion.log.trades.desc: Write every trade to the server log
config.trade_expansion.command.permissio: Permission needed for /tradeex admin subcommands (2 = op)
config.trade_expansion.client.showDebugT: Show base price etc. in trade screen tooltips (not implemented yet)
tooltip.trade_expansion.wallet_hint: Stack coins onto it to store them. Use to take coins out
screen.trade_expansion.bank.issue_card: Issue a card (fee %s, from the account)
bank.trade_expansion.result.creative_not: The bank is not available in Creative mode
trade.trade_expansion.result.card_invali: You do not carry a valid card
screen.trade_expansion.quest.select: Select a request from the list
screen.trade_expansion.board.columns: Left: buy / right: sell. Cyan ↓ = cheaper than here, pink ↑ = pays more than here. Orange name = shortage
command.trade_expansion.audit: Market #%s: %s arbitrage loops (largest profit first, up to 15)
config.trade_expansion.board.radius.desc: Horizontal distance of markets listed on the board tab
Lists up to this many markets, nearest first
config.trade_expansion.quest.maxPerMarke: Maximum open requests per market. 0 = none
config.trade_expansion.quest.refreshDays: New requests fill empty slots this often
config.trade_expansion.quest.durationDay: Requests expire after this many days
config.trade_expansion.quest.rewardMulti: Reward = total base price of the items × this
config.trade_expansion.quest.difficultyT: Requests worth at least this (base prices) are ★2
config.trade_expansion.demand.maxShortag: Maximum goods in shortage at once. 0 = off
config.trade_expansion.demand.durationDa: Shortage goods are re-chosen this often
config.trade_expansion.demand.minMultipl: Range of the base price multiplier of goods in shortage
config.trade_expansion.trader.spawnOnOpe: Spawn a trader NPC near the stall when it is opened
config.trade_expansion.villager.coinTrad: Buying from villagers is paid in coins from wallets and coins instead of emeralds
config.trade_expansion.villager.emeraldP: Conversion used when villager trades use coins
config.trade_expansion.recovery.consumab: Consumables (food, torches, fuel, logs etc., tag #trade_expansion:consumables) above the target stock are used up at target stock × this per day. 1.0 = back to the target within a day, so the market buys again
In-game days for a consumable's price shift to halve
config.trade_expansion.consumables.add.d: Item ids treated as consumables even if not in the tag #trade_expansion:consumables (e.g. minecraft:cobblestone). Also /tradeex consumable add
config.trade_expansion.consumables.remov: Item ids never treated as consumables, even if in the tag or the extra list. Also /tradeex consumable remove
command.trade_expansion.consumable.overr: Added in config: %s / excluded in config: %s
command.trade_expansion.consumable.reset: Cleared the setting for %s; the tag decides again (now: %s)
config.trade_expansion.client.balancePos: Where the trade screen shows cash and bank balance. The top-right corner may overlap buttons of other mods, so the default is right of the inventory
message.trade_expansion.rename_denied: You cannot rename this market (only whoever named it, or an operator)
command.trade_expansion.name_reset: Cleared the name of market #%s (shown as "%s")
command.trade_expansion.name_empty: The name is empty. Use reset to clear a name
config.trade_expansion.market.renamePerm: Who can rename a market with a name tag etc. In singleplayer you can always rename
command.trade_expansion.goods_set: Saved the value of %s to the config file
command.trade_expansion.goods_reset: %s uses the goods definition (data pack) value again
command.trade_expansion.goods_info: %s (%s)  key: data pack value / config value (- = not set)
message.trade_expansion.new_market.villa: You cannot found a new market here. New markets can only be founded inside a village (near an existing market the stall joins it)
message.trade_expansion.new_market.beds: You cannot found a new market here. It needs at least %2$s beds within %1$s blocks (now %3$s)
message.trade_expansion.new_market.villa: You cannot found a new market here. It needs at least %2$s villagers within %1$s blocks (now %3$s)
message.trade_expansion.new_market.beds_: You cannot found a new market here. It needs, within %s blocks, at least %s beds and %s villagers, and at least as many beds as villagers (now %s beds, %s villagers)
config.trade_expansion.market.newMarketR: Where new markets can be founded
Condition for founding a new market with a crafted stall. Joining an existing market and village stalls are not affected. In the Nether and the End only villagers count
config.trade_expansion.market.newMarketM: Beds needed for a new market
With "beds" or "beds and villagers", at least this many beds within the level radius
Villagers needed for a new market
With "villagers" or "beds and villagers", at least this many villagers within the level radius
message.trade_expansion.where.new: Placing a stall here founds a new market
message.trade_expansion.where.village: Inside a village (X %s to %s, Z %s to %s)
message.trade_expansion.where.market: Nearest market: %s (%s blocks; within %s blocks = same market, under %s blocks = no new market)
message.trade_expansion.where.no_market: There is no market in this dimension yet
message.trade_expansion.where.count_vill: Within %s blocks: %s villagers (beds are not counted in the Nether and the End)
message.trade_expansion.where.show_hint: /tradeex where show draws the ranges for 30 s (green: village, yellow: same market, red: no new market, blue: beds/villagers counted)
message.trade_expansion.where.shown: Drawing the ranges for 30 seconds (green: village, yellow: same market, red: no new market, blue: beds/villagers counted). /tradeex where hide stops it
config.trade_expansion.trade.showPlaceme: Placement hint while holding a stall
While holding a stall, the action bar shows whether placing it joins a market, founds a new one, or why it cannot
config.trade_expansion.villager.wanderin: While villager coin trades are on, buying from the wandering trader is paid in coins too
command.trade_expansion.audit_villagers: %s villagers / wandering traders nearby, %s coin trades, %s of them profit when resold at a market (largest first, up to 15)
config.trade_expansion.villager.minGoods: Minimum price of goods sold by villagers

When villagers or wandering traders sell an item that is also market goods, the price is at least base price × this × count (even far from markets). 0 = off. 1.4 is a little above the highest market sell price with variance and regional multipliers
screen.trade_expansion.board.deal_hint: Hover a market to see its deals (B: goods cheaper to buy than here, S: goods that sell for more)
config.trade_expansion.board.dealThresho: The board marks goods at least this much cheaper to buy, or paying this much more, than at the current market (or the standard price) as deals. 0.1 = 10%
